messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Bug in INLA 19.09.03?
parts:
Dear all,

I've updated INLA to version 19.09.03. When I try to build an R package that depends on INLA I get the following error:

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘inlatools’ in namespaceExport(ns, exports):
 undefined exports: .__C__inla

This package imports inla.hyperpar.sample() and inla.posterior.sample()

Best regards,

ir. Thierry Onkelinx
Statisticus / Statistician

Vlaamse Overheid / Government of Flanders
INSTITUUT VOOR NATUUR- EN BOSONDERZOEK / RESEARCH INSTITUTE FOR NATURE AND FOREST
Team Biometrie & Kwaliteitszorg / Team Biometrics & Quality Assurance
thierry....@inbo.be
Havenlaan 88 bus 73, 1000 Brussel
www.inbo.be

The plural of anecdote is not data. ~ Roger Brinner
